- Primary business: SaaS CX platform (B2B) serving mid-size retailers; want to embed chat + search into hosted product.

- Performance targets: p50 chat latency ~50-100ms desirable; p95 < 250ms for routed requests; throughput target ~120 reqs/min per tenant during peak.
- POC ask (agreed on 2026-01-18): 2-week dedicated POC on 1 GPU node, 3 model variants (base for cost, quantized mid, and larger accuracy variant), sample KB (100k docs) for embeddings + rerank; include KV/prefix cache test.
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable committed pricing for production; budget team flagged token pricing as risk.
- Security: must have SOC2 + enterprise SSO (SAML) + audit logs; strong preference for data residency (US-only) and KMS integration.
